parameters.instructions: GitHub helpers for a solo developer (default owner: <GITHUB_USERNAME>). Use list_repos to list the repositories of an owner. Every other tool needs the repository owner and name. Use list_issues to list issues (open and closed by default, optional state filter), get_issue to read one issue by number, list_prs to list pull requests (open and closed by default, optional state filter), and get_pr to read one pull request by number. Use get_file to read any file by full path, for example README.md or package.json, with an optional branch or ref. Use list_directory to browse a folder, get_pr_diff for a pull request diff, list_issue_comments for the comments on an issue or pull request, list_commits for recent commits (optional branch or path), list_releases for releases, and search_code to search code in a repository. File content is returned base64-encoded in the content field, so decode it before reading.
